biography.plain_text: Mary Ann Van Elslander is an American philanthropist who established the Van Elslander Family Foundation with her husband, furniture retailer Art Van Elslander. A longstanding community donor, she has supported children's healthcare and community services in Michigan. Her personal giving helped fund improvements to the children's hospital at St. John in Detroit.

A longstanding community donor, she has supported children's healthcare and community services in Michigan. Her personal giving helped fund improvements to the children's hospital at St. John in Detroit.

confidence.reason: Primary charitable records and contemporary interviews support the personal contributions; later institutional outcomes are not attributed to her.

long_biography.plain_text:
Michigan philanthropist Mary Ann Van Elslander made volunteering a regular commitment. At St. John Hospital, she spent four hours a week holding and changing babies and folding supplies. Working with newborns and their families encouraged her support for the neonatal intensive care unit, connecting her financial gifts with practical experience.

At Angels' Place, which provides homes for adults with developmental disabilities, she worked to broaden support beyond the organisation's established donor base. Finding that many people in Detroit's eastern suburbs knew little about its work, she planned a reception to introduce neighbours to an endowment campaign intended to sustain the homes.
